stemMd: During contraction of a skeletal-muscle sarcomere, which change is expected?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Greater overlap of actin and myosin filaments

options.label: E
options.textMd: Replacement of ATP by DNA as the motor fuel

explanationMd: Cross-bridge activity slides thin filaments past thick filaments, increasing overlap and shortening the sarcomere. The sliding-filament model does not require the filaments themselves to shorten.

distractorRationale.d: Myosin remains part of the contractile apparatus.
distractorRationale.a: Filaments slide rather than materially shorten.
